messages:
Noah - Account Exec: Team, Evan's procurement asked for formal BCP/DR proof points: measured RTO/RPO, backup cadence/encryption, failover steps, and any recent DR test artifacts. Need a gated bundle by next Tuesday.
Gina - Solutions Eng: I can assemble a tech brief. Quick stats from our Feb internal drill: failover trigger to traffic cutover = 3m 5s; KV rehydrate to 95% hit = 5m 20s; measured RTO = 8m 25s. Test: 2026-02-20.
Rhea - InfoSec: Provide SOC2 attestation link (public) and mark full report NDA-only. Also prepare CAIQ mapping. For backups: hourly incremental, daily full, 30d retention default, AES-256 encryption, KMS with customer-key option for Dedicated/Private. Snapshots are immutable for minimum 14d.
Evan - Acme IT: Procurement insists on timestamped logs from the test showing the steps. Can you share redacted logs? Also need RPO wording: hosted hourly snapshots vs Dedicated streaming replication options.
Molly - Legal: I'll flag exact SLA language to share: include the 99.95% monthly availability excerpt and note that detailed DR artifacts are available under NDA. Don't include internal IPs or emails in logs.
Gina - Solutions Eng: Draft SLA excerpt: "Redwood Dedicated: Monthly Availability 99.95%. Service credits apply per MSA Section 4.4. Customers may request DR evidence under an executed NDA."
ops-bot: dr/run/20260220 completed - artifact: s3://ops/dr-tests/2026-02-20/summary.txt
Rhea - InfoSec: Redaction checklist: remove IPs, user IDs, any tenant identifiers, and replace with placeholders. We'll provide runbook excerpts redacted and the CAIQ mapping spreadsheet.
Noah - Account Exec: Plan: 1) One-page RTO/RPO summary with measured figures and methodology, 2) link to SOC2 attestation, 3) CAIQ mapping, 4) redacted runbook excerpt + log (NDA-only), 5) SLA excerpt + pricing for a 2-week POC. Gina, can you estimate POC cost?
Gina - Solutions Eng: Two-week small Dedicated trial estimate: ~$4,800 (reserved baseline + burst). POC plan: 48h baseline, then controlled failover with live cutover while we capture metrics. Availability windows: Apr 12-16 or Apr 26-30.
Evan - Acme IT: Apr 26-30 works. We'll sign NDA quickly. Also please include any corrective actions from the last test.
Rhea - InfoSec: Last test notes: no data loss, one config drift found and rolled back, follow-up action to automate config sync. We'll summarize in the report.
Molly - Legal: I'll prepare the NDA template and confirm what can be shared publicly vs NDA-only. Noah, route NDA to Evan.
Noah - Account Exec: Action items: Gina -> one-pager + redacted logs to gated link; Rhea -> CAIQ + test summary; Molly -> NDA + SLA check; I'll send pricing + schedule. Target: deliver gated bundle by next Tue.
Evan - Acme IT: Thanks all, we'll review NDA and confirm POC start date once executed.
